newsitem.title: USA: ITT says to sells stake in arena for $650 million.
newsitem.headline: ITT says to sells stake in arena for $650 million.

text.p: ITT Corp. said Thursday it agreed sell its half interest in New York's Madison Square Garden arena to its partner Cablevision Systems Corp. for $650 million.

ITT, which is fending off a hostile $6.5 billion takeover bid from Hilton Hotels Corp., said the deal would give it an 81 percent gain in a two-year period over its original net investment of $360 million in the arena, which includes the the New York Knicks basketball and Rangers hockey professional sports teams and the MSG television network.
ITT, whose operations include the Sheraton hotel chain and Caesars casinos, said the deal values the arena and associated properties at $1.53 billion.

The sale of the arena by ITT was seen as the latest step in the New York-based hotel and casino company's defence against Hilton's takeover offer. Cablevision, which teamed up with ITT in 1995 to buy the famous arena, had been seen as the top candidate to acquire the stake from ITT.
Under the deal, Cablevision initially will pay ITT $500 million in cash for a 38.5 percent stake in Madison Square Garden.
ITT also has the option to require Woodbury, N.Y.-based Cablevision to purchase half of the remaining stake in the arean for $150 million in the two years following the closing of the deal.
